recipes.name: Mugwort rice cake (Ssuk-beomul)
ingredients: Fresh mugwort (ssuk), sweet rice flour, sugar, kosher salt, and water.
instructions: Clean 2 cups of mugwort (70 grams) by washing thoroughly and rinsing and draining in cold running water a couple of times. You may need to scrub it by hand to remove any residual dirt from between the leaves.
Slightly squeeze the clean mugwort and put it on a microwavable plate.
Add ⅓ cup sweet rice flour, 1 tbs sugar, ¼ ts kosher salt, and 2 tbs water.
Mix it up with both hands until there’s no sweet rice flour left at the bottom of the plate.
Cook it for 3-4 minutes in the microwave oven.
Take it off the plate and turn it over with a spoon or spatula.
